Im verwalteten .NET-Modell ist die Lebenszeit durch den Garbage Collector geregelt; diese Klasse bildet das Konzept als eine einfache, nicht sortierte Liste ab.

In the original C++ code "NS" (non-sorted / non-owning) meant the collection does not assume ownership of its elements. In the managed .NET model, lifetime is handled by the garbage collector; this class models the concept as a simple, unsorted list.

Sort helper class as managed counterpart to TNSSorter / TNSClass from Turbo Vision (tnssorte.cc). The original implemented a heap sort or shell sort for TCollection subclasses. In the .NET model, Array.Sort is used, which internally performs intro-sort (heap + quick + insertion).
